inputs: Public aggregate tables and literature metadata only; no patient matrices
statistical_unit: gene / metabolite-gene relation / publication record as applicable; no new tests
n_patients: NA;not recomputed;legacy counts remain author-mapped specimens

software.dependencies: Python standard library for receipt reproduction

metadata_query_template: EXT_ID:(<up to 25 PMIDs joined with OR>) AND SRC:MED
metadata_scope: 78 unique PubMed identifiers in supplied URL column; no claims of full 121-source integrity audit
metadata_fields: Identifier/title/DOI/publication types/linked notices; abstracts not redistributed
manual_notes: receiver_source_notes.tsv and key_claim_checks.tsv are bounded manual interpretations, not algorithmic proof
reporting_rule: 52 refers to imported GENETIC_BRCA category, not 52 independently verified targets
publication: Push and remote verification tracked by Git; original delivery ACCESS_BLOCKED fields are historical
cptac_role: No scoring from tissue/plex-confounded old comparison
